title: Key creator Jun Maeda has pharyngeal cancer and has chosen palliative care, his company says
dek: Maeda wrote Kanon, Clannad and Angel Beats, and is writing the last chapter of the game Heaven Burns Red. His company has said how that work will go on.
what: On October 19, 2026, the company VISUAL ARTS posted on its English X account an important announcement about its creator Jun Maeda, with the details in an attached document.

Anime News Network reports that Maeda has been diagnosed with pharyngeal cancer. It reports that after considering his condition and the outlook for treatment, he chose palliative care. It quotes the company as saying he remains determined to devote himself to creative work to the very end, and that he is in hospital.

Anime News Network also reports on his work on Heaven Burns Red. It says he has finished the first six chapters of the game, including the main story through the end of chapter six, and the lyrics and music for songs in the first half of chapter six. It says he may not be able to take on more writing and songs, depending on how the illness goes.
I could not read the attached notice myself. The facts above come from Anime News Network, which reports on that notice. Fan accounts on X repeat the same points.
why: Maeda is one of the best known writers in visual novels and anime, and many fans grew up with his work. The news came from his own company, and the accounts that passed it on quote it closely.
next: Any further notice from VISUAL ARTS on Maeda or on the remaining chapters of Heaven Burns Red.

sources.label: Anime News Network: Kanon, Air, Clannad, Heaven Burns Red's Jun Maeda in Palliative Care for Pharyngeal Cancer
